callp-c6: AI-Generated, High, 36; AI-Generated, Medium, 12; AI-Generated, High, 20

AI-Generated High (36 words): Call medics if any of these happen:
- They have a seizure after taking too much, or you don't know how much they took.
- A seizure on a normal dose goes on for over 5 minutes.

AI-Generated Medium (12 words): - Their breathing gets slow and shallow.
- Their lips turn blue or gray.

AI-Generated High (20 words): - They get dangerously hot (not just regular sweating).
- They injure their head, break a bone, or bleeding won't stop.
